states.name: Alabama
states.need: Private land, or a titled motorcycle with Class M. The §32-5A-267 e-bike exemption does not attach.
states.helmet: DOT helmet, all ages, if treated as a motorcycle. Class 3 e-bike 16+ does not apply.
states.notes: Pedals + under 750 W + class caps required for e-bike status. Untitled retail sale is normal; untitled road use is not.
states.ohv: Private property, or designated motorized OHV areas under land-manager rules.
states.takeaway: Alabama’s e-bike exemption is only for pedals + under 750 W + class speed caps, so a HAVØK is a motorcycle. Untitled retail sale is normal; untitled public-road riding is not.
